d: Cyclone Murasu makes landfall in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh. The cyclone brings 120 kmph winds and heavy rains to the Andhra coast. Murasu is the second cyclone to make landfall in Andhra Pradesh in a week, after Cyclone Arnab last Wednesday. Firstpost also looks at the eruption of Hawaii's Kilauea volcano. Hem Kaur Saroya looks at how the Soviet Union's Laika the dog became the first living creature in orbit in 1957. HKS also shows you the Sao Paulo zombie walk.
